backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the chat backend, managing rooms, messages (with 24-hour TTL), user profiles, reactions, and media files, with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the removal of the GIF/sticker MediaPicker component from the chat UI, listing affected files and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each component, hook, and utility in the project.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the React app, setting dark mode, viewport meta, and mounting the app into a div with id 'root'.
frontend/REDEPLOY_TRIGGER.txt: A placeholder file used to trigger CI/CD rebuilds without changing application logic, tracking a build trigger count.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing current room and nickname state, toggling between WelcomeScreen and ChatRoom views, and preventing body scroll when in a chat room.
frontend/src/components/AudioRecorder.ts: Audio recording component with start/stop controls, preview playback, a 5-minute max duration, and send/cancel functionality with microphone permission handling.
frontend/src/components/ChatRoom.tsx: Main chat interface supporting message sending, editing, replies, image uploads, audio/video recording, emoji picking, and reactions; the GIF/sticker MediaPicker has been removed.
frontend/src/components/EmojiPicker.tsx: Emoji picker popup organized into four categories (Smileys, Gestures, Hearts, Objects) that calls a callback when an emoji is selected.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top header displaying the SecureChat branding and an optional Leave Room button when the user is in a chat room.
frontend/src/components/MediaPicker.tsx: Empty file representing the deleted or disabled MediaPicker component that previously provided GIF and sticker selection functionality.
frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.ts: Renders a single chat message bubble with support for reactions, replies, edit/delete actions, media (image/video/audio) playback and download, and optimistic message display.
frontend/src/components/VideoRecorder.ts: Provides a UI component for recording video via the user's camera with a 2-minute limit, live preview, and sending the recorded blob.
frontend/src/components/VideoUploader.ts: Allows users to select, preview, and send a local video file (MP4/WebM/MOV/AVI, max 50MB) with upload progress feedback.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeScreen.ts: Displays the initial screen where users can create or join a chat room by entering a room code and nickname.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageVisibility.ts: Simple hook that tracks and returns whether the browser tab/document is currently visible using the Page Visibility API.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for backend operations including creating/joining rooms, checking room existence, fetching messages, and sending/editing/deleting messages with error handling and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useVisualViewportOffs: Hook that tracks the Visual Viewport API to compute keyboard-induced bottom offset on mobile (coarse pointer) devices, returning zero offset on desktop to prevent floating input bars.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives, defines light/dark CSS custom properties for the design system, and adds mobile-specific utilities for safe areas, viewport height, and iOS input zoom prevention.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/chatErrorMessages.ts: Maps known backend IC reject messages and error strings to user-friendly error messages for chat operations.
frontend/src/utils/chatLayoutRegressionC: Dev-only utility that validates the scroll container and input composer DOM elements in ChatRoom have correct layout properties, logging warnings for detected issues.
frontend/src/utils/chatOperationErrors.t: Utility that extracts and logs structured error details (IC reject code/message, error type) for chat operations, returning a typed error log object.
frontend/src/utils/downloadImage.ts: Deprecated utilities for downloading images via anchor click or from Blob/Uint8Array, with PNG extension enforcement; superseded by downloadMedia.ts.
frontend/src/utils/downloadMedia.ts: Media download utilities supporting uploaded images in their original format, URL-sourced images converted to PNG via canvas, and video downloads as MP4.
frontend/src/utils/icRejectDetails.ts: Utility for extracting and normalizing IC (Internet Computer) reject codes and messages from unknown error shapes, including nested and wrapped error structures.
frontend/src/utils/messageNonce.ts: Generates a cryptographically-random nonce string for message deduplication, with fallbacks for environments lacking full Crypto API support.
frontend/src/utils/mime.ts: Provides MIME type validation, extension-to-MIME and MIME-to-extension mapping utilities for image, video, and audio file types.
frontend/src/utils/retry.ts: Implements exponential backoff retry logic for async functions, with transient error classification based on error messages and IC reject codes.
frontend/src/utils/roomId.ts: Exports a single function that normalizes room IDs by trimming whitespace for consistent room identification.
frontend/src/utils/toastOnce.ts: Deduplicates toast notifications by tracking recently shown toasts within a 3-second window, exposing error, success, and info variants.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and hash cleanup helpers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a room-based chat app where GIF and sticker features have been removed, tracking existing features, known issues, and schema version.
